result.note: Skilling PPP with a clear shareholding structure and locations; one statements question on ownership split and sites.

questions.prompt: In October 2026, the Centre, two state governments and ArcelorMittal Nippon Steel India signed shareholder agreements to upgrade nine government industrial training institutes (ITIs). Consider the following statements about this arrangement:
items: The steelmaker will hold 51% of each company established to manage the ITI clusters.
The Centre and the respective state government will each hold 24.5% in these companies.
Five of the institutes are in Surat and four are in Visakhapatnam.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: All three are correct. The steelmaker takes a 51% majority, the Centre and the state government hold 24.5% each, and the nine ITIs are split between Surat in Gujarat and Visakhapatnam in Andhra Pradesh. The approved investment is about INR 4.4 billion, covering modernised workshops and laboratories, revised courses and instructor training.
questions.source: The steelmaker will hold 51% of each company established to manage the clusters, with the Centre and respective state governments holding 24.5% each.
